_about: What scouts look for, grouped the way the app shows it (Me › Growth): Skills, Reading the game, Body, Goalkeeping, Attitude.

Each item lists the measurements ('metrics') that feed it, newest data first in 'metrics' order. 'average' is how the measured value is said in plain words: {v} is the value, {kmh} the value in km/h, {pct} the value as a percentage.
'key' = positions for which this item matters most (a small dot in the app). 'positions' = only show it for these positions (omit = everyone).
'state': coming_later = Pep will measure this once event detection lands; cant_see = video can't show it (a coach or test can).
Football opinion: review with coaches. Changing a band threshold is in pep/players/skill_areas.py.
